December's bad reviews had two different causes, not one: one merchant's ratings have genuinely declined 3 years running (4.43→3.71→3.14) tied to a real delivery breakdown, while another's dip looks like fragile items (vases, plates) breaking in transit — damage-related returns run 4-7x higher for breakable home goods (27-40%) than for soft goods like bedding (3.6%).

Bundles are a real, untapped opportunity in specific categories: every merchant selling beauty, food/coffee, books, electronics, jewelry, or home goods has tried bundling at least once, but literally zero merchants in apparel, pet supplies, sports, or B2B wholesale have — and even adopters only bundle 2-5% of their catalog.
A small but telling catalog gap: 85 product listings with zero photos are our OLDEST listings on the platform (avg 3+ years old), not new ones awaiting content — an easy, overdue cleanup.
